use net:System.Math as NetMath
use net:System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex as Rx
use js:"node:path/posix" as path
use go:strings as gstr

unit m
unit km = 1000 m
unit g
unit kg = 1000 g
currency EUR, SEK

record LegInput {
    route: Text
    dx_km: Float
    dy_km: Float
    weight_g: Float
    zone: Text
}

record QuoteRequest {
    eur_to_sek: Float
    max_sek: Int
    legs: List[LegInput]
}

record EvaluatedLeg {
    depot: Text
    zone: Text
    valid: Bool
    dist_km: Float[km]
    weight_kg: Float[kg]
    heavy: Bool
    long_haul: Bool
    vip_exempt: Bool
    fee_eur: Float[EUR]
    fee_eur_cents: Int
}

fn is_valid_zone(zone: Text) -> Bool pure =
    zone == "SE" or zone == "EU" or zone == "NON-EU"

fn is_valid_leg(depot_ok: Bool, zone: Text) -> Bool pure =
    depot_ok and is_valid_zone(zone)

fn base_leg_fee(dist: Float[km], weight: Float[kg]) -> Float[EUR] pure =
    (5.0 + 0.5 * scalar(dist) + 2.0 * scalar(weight)) as EUR

fn distance_multiplier(km_val: Float) -> Float pure = cases km_val {
    <= 50.0 => 1.0
    <= 200.0 => 1.15
    else => 1.35
}

fn is_heavy_weight(weight: Float[kg]) -> Bool pure =
    scalar(weight) >= 10.0

fn is_long_haul(dist: Float[km]) -> Bool pure =
    scalar(dist) > 100.0

fn is_vip_exempt(depot: Text, zone: Text) -> Bool pure =
    depot == "sto-01" and zone == "SE"

fn apply_zone_adjustment(fee: Float[EUR], zone: Text) -> Float[EUR] pure =
    if zone == "SE" then fee * 0.9
    else if zone == "NON-EU" then fee + (15.0 as EUR)
    else fee

fn leg_fee(dist: Float[km], weight: Float[kg], depot: Text, zone: Text) -> Float[EUR] pure =
    let multiplied: Float[EUR] = base_leg_fee(dist, weight) * distance_multiplier(scalar(dist)) in
    let heavy_surcharge: Float[EUR] =
        if is_vip_exempt(depot, zone) then (0.0 as EUR)
        else if is_heavy_weight(weight) then (12.0 as EUR)
        else (0.0 as EUR) in
    let with_heavy: Float[EUR] = multiplied + heavy_surcharge in
    apply_zone_adjustment(with_heavy, zone)

fn eur_to_sek_amount(amount: Float[EUR], rate: Float) -> Float[SEK] pure =
    (scalar(amount) * rate) as SEK

fn evaluate_leg(leg: LegInput) -> EvaluatedLeg =
    let norm = path.normalize(leg.route) in
    let depot = path.basename(norm) in
    let zone = gstr.ToUpper(gstr.TrimSpace(leg.zone)) in
    let depot_ok = Rx.IsMatch(depot, "^[a-z]{3}-[0-9]{2}$") in
    let valid = is_valid_leg(depot_ok, zone) in
    let dist_km: Float[km] = NetMath.Sqrt(leg.dx_km * leg.dx_km + leg.dy_km * leg.dy_km) as km in
    let weight_g: Float[g] = leg.weight_g as g in
    let weight_kg: Float[kg] = weight_g to kg in
    let heavy = is_heavy_weight(weight_kg) in
    let long_haul = is_long_haul(dist_km) in
    let vip_exempt = heavy and is_vip_exempt(depot, zone) in
    let fee_eur: Float[EUR] = leg_fee(dist_km, weight_kg, depot, zone) in
    let fee_eur_cents = round_even(scalar(fee_eur) * 100.0) in
    EvaluatedLeg(
        depot: depot,
        zone: zone,
        valid: valid,
        dist_km: dist_km,
        weight_kg: weight_kg,
        heavy: heavy,
        long_haul: long_haul,
        vip_exempt: vip_exempt,
        fee_eur: fee_eur,
        fee_eur_cents: fee_eur_cents
    )

let req: QuoteRequest = from_json(stdin_text())
let evaluated = [evaluate_leg(leg) for leg in req.legs]
let valid_evaluated = [leg for leg in evaluated where leg.valid]
let long_haul_pairs = count adjacent past, now in valid_evaluated where past.long_haul and now.long_haul

let totals = summarize leg in evaluated {
    legs: count
    valid_legs: count where leg.valid
    heavy_legs: count where leg.valid and leg.heavy
    customs_legs: count where leg.valid and leg.zone == "NON-EU"
    vip_exempt: count where leg.valid and leg.vip_exempt
    total_km: sum leg.dist_km where leg.valid
    total_eur: sum leg.fee_eur where leg.valid
    max_leg_eur_cents: max leg.fee_eur_cents where leg.valid default 0
}

let rest_fee: Float[EUR] = (25.0 * to_float(long_haul_pairs)) as EUR
let final_eur: Float[EUR] = totals.total_eur + rest_fee
let total_m_qty: Float[m] = totals.total_km to m
let total_sek_qty: Float[SEK] = eur_to_sek_amount(final_eur, req.eur_to_sek)
let total_sek = round_even(scalar(total_sek_qty))
let within_cap = total_sek <= req.max_sek

let out = record {
    legs: totals.legs,
    valid_legs: totals.valid_legs,
    total_m: round_even(scalar(total_m_qty)),
    total_eur_cents: round_even(scalar(final_eur) * 100.0),
    total_sek: total_sek,
    heavy_legs: totals.heavy_legs,
    customs_legs: totals.customs_legs,
    long_haul_pairs: long_haul_pairs,
    vip_exempt: totals.vip_exempt,
    within_cap: within_cap,
    max_leg_eur_cents: totals.max_leg_eur_cents
}

print json_encode(out)
